entries.title: Accessibility: VoiceOver, Reduce Motion and large text

entries.title: Which model keys you need, and the setups
ask: do i need all the keys
entries.how: Any one of these is enough to start: (a) one Gemini key (free tier; about $0.70 to $0.95 a busy hour with billing on), (b) one OpenAI key (about $0.95 a busy hour), (c) Soniox + Anthropic API keys (about $1.20). Fastest and most accurate voice: Anthropic + Soniox + ElevenLabs (+ Gemini for the checker), about $1 a busy hour. Why its own keys? Pointe runs its own models next to Claude Code: the brain, the reader and the checker, the ears and the voice. Your Claude subscription (Pro or Max) runs Claude Code, but has no interface other apps can use, so Pointe's voice needs its own API key from console.anthropic.com, or one Gemini or OpenAI key. An API key is billed per use: about $1 for a busy hour of talk. Switch setups with pointe setup on the Mac.
entries.iphone_note: The keys live in the Mac's Keychain: see them in the page's or the Mac app's Settings, Model keys.
entries.page_note: It shows the setup in use, each key as In use, Saved, not used, Needed or Optional, and the setups. On the Mac's own page, Add… or Replace… opens the vendor's key page and a window for the key, which Pointe checks before it restarts on it; Use this setup switches. On the phone, keys are added on the Mac.
entries.mac_note: In the Mac app's Settings, under Model keys: the Setup menu, each key's state, and Add…, which opens the vendor's key page and the window for the key, checks it, and restarts Pointe on it.
